title: Single hieratic sign, Berlin, Ägyptisches Museum und Papyrussammlung, P 3048 rto (AKU HT 68401)

object.name: Berlin, Ägyptisches Museum und Papyrussammlung, P 3048 rto

source.attribution: Georg Möller, Hieratische Paläographie, retro-digitised by AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 68401

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 68401; AKU grapheme R0110 (AKU GR 529). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: R11 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 541. Source publication of this facsimile: Möller 1936a. Occurrence: line 1; find place Theben; writing direction "Zeilen, linksläufig prograd"; sign size 15.3 x 14.5 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Dritte Zwischenzeit, 22.–23. Dynastie". Facsimile type: Retro-Digitalisat (Publikation), by Georg Möller. Source scan (WEBP) converted to PNG at native resolution, flattened onto white, white margin added.
